query: After upgrading ComfyUI to v0.3.48, WanVideoDecode node fails: MetadataHook async_map_node_over_list_with_metadata() got an unexpected keyword argument 'hidden_inputs'.

desired.outcome: kijai diagnosed the conflict with Anything-Anywhere nodes; removing those nodes fixed the error. OP confirmed "that fixed it".
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver blames the correct third-party pack (Anything-Anywhere hooking node metadata) instead of the WanVideoWrapper or ComfyUI v0.3.48 itself.
